name: 68114 · Omaha, NE
findings: ZIP 68114 (Omaha) has 176 nonprofit organizations. 65 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 53 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 68114 (Omaha) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 68114 (Omaha) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 53 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.
